title: The car and the plane you can carry
summary: Two of the valuables in R.E.P.O. are working vehicles as well as loot: the car has wheels, a driver and its own sounds, and the plane takes off according to how fast it is going.
body: Two of the valuables are vehicles rather than objects. A car and a plane can be picked up as loot, and both are built as working machines with parts of their own.

The car has everything a car needs. There is a body, front wheels and back wheels, a driver with a body and arms, and a curve for the body and one for the arms, so the driver moves with the car rather than sitting in it.
It sounds like a car. It has a horn, a start, a stop and a running loop of its own, which is how a valuable can announce itself from the other side of a level.
It carries two physical materials: one for standing still and one for moving. That pair is what lets the game give it grip while it is being driven and behave differently when it is being dragged.
The plane has a body, a pilot, a propeller, wheels and a crank. It is started by hand, and it has a crank loop alongside its starting and stopping sounds and a loop for when it is flying.

It takes off according to speed. There is a speed at which it leaves the ground, a lift per unit of speed and a maximum lift force, along with a cruising speed and a flight speed, which is why it can be taxied or flown rather than only driven.
Both are trap valuables. Disturbing one can set it off, and its rarity decides how likely that is, which is why a car sitting in a room is a decision rather than a free payday.
Both also have a centre transform and their own colliders, so the game knows where they are and what they can hit while they are moving.
The image beside this entry is the game's own: the colour texture of the car valuable.
What this entry does not tell you: what either vehicle is worth, how fast they go, or how much damage they do when they move. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: It has sounds for the horn and for starting, stopping and running.
It has colliders and two physical materials, one for standing still and one for moving.
The plane has a body, a pilot, a propeller, wheels and a crank.
facts.evidence: identifiers: ValuablePlane, planeBody, pilot, propeller, wheels, crank

facts.claim: It takes off according to speed, with a lift per unit of speed and a maximum lift force, and it has a cruising and a flight speed.
facts.evidence: identifiers: takeOffSpeed, liftPerSpeed, maxLiftForce, cruiseSpeed, flightSpeed

facts.claim: It has starting, stopping and flying sounds along with a crank loop.
Both are trap valuables, with the usual trigger states and a rarity level for triggering.
facts.evidence: identifiers: ValuableCar, ValuablePlane, trapTriggered, trapActive, trapActivateRarityLevel

facts.claim: Both have a centre transform and colliders of their own.
